description: This bar chart illustrates the sample counts for different essay types, categorized as Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository. The horizontal axis displays the essay types, labeled alphabetically from left to right, while the vertical axis, labeled “Sample Count,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120, with tick marks at 20-unit intervals. Four bars are present, each corresponding to an essay type, and are colored light blue and light red. For the “Argumentative” essay type, a light blue bar reaches a value of 79, while a light red bar reaches a value of 122. For “Narrative” essays, the light blue bar reaches 80 and the light red bar reaches 87. The “Descriptive” essay type is represented by a light blue bar at 68 and a light red bar at 100. Finally, “Expository” essays are represented by a light blue bar at 62 and a light red bar at 130. The bars are grouped, with each pair representing the counts for “Open” and “Cons.” essay types as indicated in the legend, and are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
